card.name: Inside hyphenated medical compounds
card.fires_on: The hyphen, space or word piece that sits in the middle of a compound medical term, where the next piece must continue it, such as Life-Threatening, renin-angiotensin, beta-adrenergic, or feco-oral.

modes.label: Hyphen in compound
modes.description: A hyphen joining parts of a medical compound before the second part.

modes.label: Partway through long term
modes.description: A short piece in the middle of a long medical word such as angiotensin or adrenal.

modes.label: Gap inside a number
modes.description: A space inside a rate or phone number, just before the digits continue.

card.writes: It seems to hold back unrelated continuations so the model finishes the compound term in the usual way.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of hyphenated or long medical terms, where the rest of the term is still to come.
